heading: INQUIRY
subtitle: Probe an engram in her own voice, or develop her — request a change and watch her reshape her own environment

developmentNote: Development mutates only bounded fields (mood, drives, cadence, threshold, focus, learned facts). Core identity and safety framing are immutable.
